title: Return-Record Courtesy on Delivery Claims Wrong-Item Keep Charges
content:
Under Delivery Claims, a customer who keeps a wrong item receives a courtesy on the keep charge according to the returns they have settled with Returns & Exchanges over the past year.

**Courtesy.** The return-record courtesy depends on the customer's returns in status settled whose settled date falls in the trailing 12 calendar months: none gives 5%, one or two give 2%, and three or more give none.

Counted: the customer's Returns & Exchanges return cases whose status is settled and whose settled date falls in the 12 calendar months up to today. Returns that are open, cancelled or settled earlier than that are not counted.

| Settled returns in the trailing 12 calendar months | Return-record courtesy |
|---|---|
| none | 5% |
| 1 or 2 | 2% |
| 3 or more | none |

## Cases (hypothetical return histories)

- No returns at all: 5%.
- One return settled 4 months ago and one still open: 1 settled return — 2%.
- Two returns settled this year and one settled 13 months ago: 2 counted — 2%.
- Three returns settled in the last 12 months: none.
